summary: Frontend-only validation of editable Origin/Destination address fields in /taxi (consumer). Verified editable input, autocomplete via /taxi/geocode, save/select/remove of saved addresses, test points fallback, and full quote flow. All flows passed.
critical_code_review_comments: AddressField uses 1e-4 lat/lng tolerance to detect 'saved' state via star fill - acceptable but two nearby addresses could collide (minor).

onFocus clears q and shows value in input only when panel closed; UX is fine, but if user tabs out without selecting a suggestion the field appears empty until refocus (works because value?.address is shown when panel closed).
Nominatim usage is unbounded per keystroke (with 450ms debounce); consider server-side caching for rate-limit resilience (already noted as external dependency).
seed_data_creation: Created one saved address via POST /taxi/addresses (Avenida Paulista, Consolação, São Paulo) and then removed it in the same run — no residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on mobile viewport (390x844). Steps: login as consumer -> /taxi -> focus taxi-origin-input opens panel with GPS/Locais de teste; typing 'Avenida Paulista' returns real suggestions in taxi-origin-input-sugg-0; clicking sugg fills the field; taxi-origin-input-save persists it; refocus shows taxi-origin-input-saved-<id>; clicking selects it; taxi-origin-input-remove-<id> deletes it. Full quote flow with Centro→Shopping test points returned R$ 18,51 in taxi-suggested-price.
